about:
Hello, 👋

I am Satnam, welcome to my LinkedIn Profile. 🌟

As a seasoned transformation change leader, I am the go-to leader for organizations 
grappling with the challenges of any transformation change. 💼

Recognised for my ability to overcome hurdles and drive successful outcomes, I 
specialise in guiding C-Suite teams through the intricate landscape of Business transformations involving systems overhauls. 🚀

Typically, I am Headhunted for my expertise which helps companies address challenges with:
• Change Management 🔄
• Data Migration/Integration 📊 
• Customisation vs. Standardisation 🛠
• Scope Control 🎯
• Regulatory Compliance 📜
• Vendor Collaboration 🤝
• Transformational Leadership 🌐
• Impact on Efficiency and Profitability 💰

Experienced with various technologu platforms
***Oracle cloud ERP, D365 ERP, SAP ERP, SalesForce and others***

If you or your client have these challenges and want help to fix them, please contact me 
by DM, Email, or phone. 📬📞. satnamconsultingltd@gmail.com, +(44)7879 772 967.
